_comment: `broken` is GENERATED by scripts/verify-butterchurn-presets.mjs — presets that threw or killed the WebGL context. `manual` is HAND-MAINTAINED and preserved across regeneration. Both are subtracted by scripts/build-butterchurn-presets.mjs. Re-run the verifier if butterchurn-presets is upgraded.

manual.name: Unchained - All You Can Eat
manual.reason: Wedges the render loop. Its frame equations call randint(5), so it takes a RANDOM branch each run: it rendered fine once in isolation (5 ms load, 1-6 ms/frame) and then hung the JS twice in a row in the verifier — hard enough that browser.close() blocked for five minutes. No loop exists in its equations, so the wedge is inside the rasteriser, on a value the random branch produces. Software rendering (SwiftShader) is what was measured and a real GPU would likely survive it, so the verifier correctly refuses to condemn it on a timeout — but a preset that can freeze the tab is not worth 1/1754th of a library, and a random branch means 'it worked when I tried it' proves nothing. Excluded by hand, 2026-08-06.
